entities.name: Miklós Esterházy de Galántha
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Count Miklós "Nikolaus" Esterházy de Galántha was a Hungarian noble and diplomat from the Esterházy family. He served as an Imperial and Royal Chamberlain, Privy Councilor, and diplomat who served as Empress Maria Theresa's Envoy to Russia between 1761 and 1763.
